headline: Depot: 13 prices, 7 limits changed (removed “$0.004 / minute”; added “$0.006 / minute”)
removed: "Around here, we say PostHog ships weirdly fast, and you can't say PostHog ships weirdly fast if you're waiting for an hour and 45 minutes."
GitHub Actions builds can use from 2 vCPUs and 8 GB of memory up to 64 vCPUs and 256 GB. With support for Intel, Arm, and macOS runners. Billed per minute, tracked per second.
Docker builds can use from 16 vCPUs and 32 GB of memory up to 64 vCPUs and 128 GB, allowing for efficient, parallel computation of the Dockerfile graph. Billed per minute, tracked per second.

The Developer plan is perfect for solo developers, side-projects, and experiments. It includes 500 Docker build minutes, 2,000 GitHub Actions minutes, 2,000 Depot CI minutes, and 1 user, with additional usage billed monthly.

The Startup plan is great for teams building production applications. It includes 5,000 Docker build minutes, 20,000 GitHub Actions minutes, 20,000 Depot CI minutes, and unlimited users, with additional usage billed monthly.

The Developer and Startup plans each include 1,000,000 passing test results per month at no charge. After that, it's $0.000001 per passing test, or $1 per 1 million tests. Failed, errored, and skipped tests are free.
